description.en: Rotary union provides the section names for Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes. Electric 10 Series is a compact electric pump made in Xingtai. The sheet identifies the machine and leaves pipe, piston and seal sizes blank. Those blanks are missing fields. They are not filled by Electric 15 or Electric 20.
description.zh: 《Rotary union》为Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes提供章节名。电动10系列是邢台制造的紧凑型电动泵。参数页写明了机器，把管子、活塞和密封尺寸留空。这些空格是缺字段。不能用电动15或电动20去填。

h1.en: Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes restated in the order of Rotary union
h1.zh: 按《Rotary union》的次序重述Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes

directAnswer.en: Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Rotary union, and that page is not a second nameplate. Electric 10 Series is a compact electric pump made in Xingtai. The sheet identifies the machine and leaves pipe, piston and seal sizes blank. Those blanks are missing fields. They are not filled by Electric 15 or Electric 20.
directAnswer.zh: Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《Rotary union》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 电动10系列是邢台制造的紧凑型电动泵。参数页写明了机器，把管子、活塞和密封尺寸留空。这些空格是缺字段。不能用电动15或电动20去填。

body.en: The heading “Function” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. Model Electric 10 Series. Motor 15 kW. Output 21 m³/h. Maximum outlet pressure 23 MPa. Hopper 0.1 m³. Horizontal distance 25 m. Aggregate 2 cm and below. Size 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Weight 400 kg. No vertical-distance cell is in this list. No delivery-pipe diameter is in this list. Electric 15 prints 15 kW, output 8–10 m³/h, and delivery pipe 100–125 mm. Electric 20 prints 22 kW and delivery pipe 80 mm. Wear-part pages list piston and seal sizes without naming Electric 10 Series. B500S-83D is another compact page, at 7.5 kW, with a hose cell that says Standard. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 标题“函数”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 型号 Electric 10 Series。电机 15 kW。输送量 21 m³/h。最大出口压力 23 MPa。料斗 0.1 m³。水平距离 25 m。骨料 2 cm 及以下。外形 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。重量 400 kg。这份清单里没有垂直距离格。也没有输送管内径。 电动15印 15 kW、输送量 8–10 m³/h、输送管 100–125 mm。电动20印 22 kW、输送管 80 mm。易损件页列出活塞和密封尺寸，但没有点名电动10系列。B500S-83D 是另一台紧凑机，7.5 kW，胶管格写“标准”。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: “Composition” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Name Electric 10 Series. State that pipe DN, piston OD and seal kit are not printed. Do not attach Electric 15's 100–125 mm. Electric 10 Series is a compact electric pump made in Xingtai. The sheet identifies the machine and leaves pipe, piston and seal sizes blank. Those blanks are missing fields. They are not filled by Electric 15 or Electric 20. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “组成”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明电动10系列。写明管径、活塞外径和密封套件都没有印出。不要附上电动15的 100–125 mm。 电动10系列是邢台制造的紧凑型电动泵。参数页写明了机器，把管子、活塞和密封尺寸留空。这些空格是缺字段。不能用电动15或电动20去填。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Uses”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Stop when the printed fragment stops. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotary_union
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“用途”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotary_union

question.en: Which printed fragment stays in force when the section is “Function” for Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes?
question.zh: 章节为“函数”时，Electric 10 Series missing spare sizes仍以哪一句已印文字为准？

answer.en: No. Output is 21 m³/h on Electric 10 Series and 8–10 m³/h on Electric 15. Only Electric 15 prints a pipe diameter. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。电动10系列的输送量是 21 m³/h，电动15是 8–10 m³/h。只有电动15印了管径。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

answer.en: No. It is the horizontal pumping-distance cell. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 不是。它是水平输送距离格。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
